description.value:
Starting at 14th level, your connection to the Feywild grows stronger and allows you to influence the chaotic energy flowing through you. When you finish a long rest, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table — this is your influenced roll. You can replace the result of any roll on the Wild Magic Surge table with your influenced roll.

You regain a spent influenced roll when you cast a 5th-level or higher spell. If you already have an influenced roll available, you can roll another one instead and choose which effect to keep.

source.custom: Fimblewood Academy homebrew, adapted from "Circle of Wild Magic" by u/Jigui26 (GM Binder, 2022).
